name: Gaussian Density Field Representation
definition: A compact representation of the density field $D$ as a weighted sum of Gaussians plus a hashed residual field $F$, allowing efficient modeling of fine density details.
summary: Gaussian Density Field Representation models density as weighted Gaussians plus a hashed residual field, separating coarse structure from high-frequency details to avoid aliasing artifacts common in pure Gaussian splatting.
